designAsBuilt.service: CampaignPersistenceService.ts: saveCampaign runs campaignRecordRow.plan (read-only: row read, D2 gate, sourceReplayFence guard, baseVersion CAS; returns the record to store or saveCampaign's refusal) and then campaignRecordRow.write (the INSERT OR REPLACE) in its own transaction, as before
designAsBuilt.journalSave: campaignRecordJournalSave.ts saveCampaignRecordThroughJournal: appendPreparedWithExtension; prepare = campaignRecordRow.plan on the writer handle, a refusal returns before any write; the snapshot of the planned record (genesis at sequence 0, checkpoint at the root head revision); a projection refusal returns before any write. extend = campaignRecordRow.write, then append(); a committed genesis writes the journal-native marker on the same handle; a genesis refused by the revision or command-identity guard keeps the row with no marker; every other non-committed append throws (rollback)
designAsBuilt.snapshot: campaignSourceGenesis.ts campaignSnapshotCommand builds the CampaignSnapshotPublished command for both purposes; appendCampaignGenesis uses it for the genesis it appends on its own (adoption, seeding); maybeAppendCampaignGenesisOnCreate removed (its one caller was the route)
designAsBuilt.route: [id].ts PUT: authority journal -> checkpoint; else baseVersion 0 and isCampaignJournalAuthorityEnabled() -> genesis; else saveCampaign. invalid-campaign-projection -> 500 "campaign <purpose> failed: <reason>" with nothing written
designAsBuilt.adoptHeader: adopt.ts file header (lines 1-27) rewritten to what the route does (genesis + journal-native marker under journal authority, then the record through saveCampaign in its own transaction; a retried adoption finishes an interrupted one)

nonClaims: Playwright was not run (charter): the fixture-armed e2e groups (authority-recovery, the two-process privacy and convergence specs) were not exercised with the checkpoint path.

The flag is unchanged: in production the genesis transaction runs only when isCampaignJournalAuthorityEnabled() is true (today only under the e2e fixture arm); the create rows reach it through a test-module replacement of that resolver, not through the production flag or the arm.
The checkpoint path is exercised only on the root branch and with no projection-rebuild lease active; the PUT does not consult that lease and nothing here proves the interaction.
The checkpoint is not fanned out to live co-op guests; no guest mirror was measured.
The adopt route still appends its genesis and creates its record in two transactions (only its header changed, as the ledger says).
The authority decision is read before the transaction (as the blocked check is); the race it leaves was not exercised.
Whether real client envelopes fail the projection (and so now answer 500 on a journal-native save) is UNVERIFIED.

findingsReportedNotFixed.finding: comments still name maybeAppendCampaignGenesisOnCreate, which this unit removed (the PUT create now appends the genesis through saveCampaignRecordThroughJournal). Outside this unit's paths; U35d owns e2e and scripts/e2e.

adoption appends the genesis and writes the marker, then creates the record through saveCampaign in a second transaction; a failure between them leaves a journal-native campaign with no row until the retry (which the route finishes: marker journal -> already-journaled -> record created). Not in this unit's sentence (header only).

a checkpoint replaces the journal state wholesale with the record projection, which leaves pilots and contracts empty (as the genesis does) and overwrites journal-only command effects (SpendFunds, AdvanceDay, HirePilot append without rewriting the row) that the saved envelope does not carry. This is the decided option (i); recorded for the owner ruling.
the removed maybeAppendCampaignGenesisOnCreate block took two tests with it (campaign group 2975 -> 2973); the route-level create is now pinned by the new suite instead.

risksForTheParent: Review classes authority + migration + idempotency: the owner's head-bound Lane B ruling is required on the head that merges; U35d (the flip) depends on this unit landing first.

Authority: a checkpoint REPLACES the journal's projected state (CampaignSnapshotPublished replaces state wholesale, applyCampaignEvent.ts:75) with the record's projection. Journal-only command effects since the last row materialization (only AcceptContract rewrites the row; SpendFunds, AdvanceDay, HirePilot and the rest append only) are overwritten by a PUT at the current row version whose envelope does not carry them, and the projection leaves pilots and contracts empty as the genesis does. This is option (i) as the ledger decided; the ruling should name it.

The authority decision (journal vs snapshot) is read before the transaction, as the blocked check is today; a marker that turns journal between that read and the save lets that one save take the snapshot path.

Migration: no schema change and the flag is unchanged, but the checkpoint path is live now for every campaign that already carries a journal marker (fixture-armed e2e runs, operator cutovers, co-op campaigns created under the arm), independent of U35d.

Idempotency: the checkpoint command id is campaign-checkpoint:<id>:<sequence>; a retried PUT is a fresh CAS attempt (its baseVersion is stale after a commit, so it answers 409 and appends nothing). The genesis keeps appendCampaignGenesis's identity (campaign-genesis:<id>).
Not in the sentence and not built: the checkpoint is not fanned out to live co-op guests, and the PUT does not consult the projection-rebuild lease that blocks commands.

Playwright is not run in this lane: fixture-armed e2e groups (authority-recovery, the two-process privacy and convergence specs) now see a checkpoint event after a whole-envelope save of a journal-native campaign.

Behavior change on journal-native campaigns only: a whole-envelope save whose envelope the projection refuses (a unit in two forces, a roster unit with no catalog ref or an invalid source) now answers 500 and is not saved; before it was saved with the journal left behind.
